caveats: SUBSTITUTION: mistralai/mistral-large-2512 has no separately-published benchmark numbers under that exact Dec-2025 build. All Mistral Large cells use the closest published version, Mistral Large 2 / 24.11 (mistral-large-2411). Relative-ordering assumption: the 2512 build is at least as capable, so using 2411 is conservative and does not invert the panel ranking (Mistral sits near the bottom regardless).

APPLES-TO-ORANGES (GAIA): GAIA numbers come from DIFFERENT scaffolds — GPT-4.1 49.7% and DeepSeek-V3 29.4% from HAL/Princeton Generalist-Agent scaffold; Gemini 2.5 Pro 33.3% from PricePerToken's leaderboard (unknown scaffold). GAIA is heavily agent-scaffold-dependent, so the GPT-4.1 > Gemini ordering on this single benchmark is NOT reliable. Because scores are min-max normalized and averaged across benchmarks, GAIA contributes only 1 of 5-6 cells; treat the GAIA column as low-confidence.

SWE-bench Verified harness variance: GPT-4.1 54.6% and Claude Sonnet 4 72.7% are provider-reported on their own bash/file-edit scaffolds; Gemini 2.5 Pro 63.8% is Google's agentic harness; DeepSeek-V3 38.8% is a third-party OpenHands run. Harnesses differ, but the ordering (Claude > Gemini > GPT-4.1 > DeepSeek; open models unreported) is stable and consistent with general reputation.

RULER is effectively non-load-bearing here: only 1 of 6 models (Mistral Large 2411, 86.0 avg from NVIDIA repo) has a clean composite RULER score at a comparable context sweep. With a single non-null cell, the RULER column cannot contribute to cross-model ranking and each model's composite is the mean of its OTHER available normalized cells. Consider dropping RULER from G3 or flagging it as coverage=1.
MRCR context length = 128k for all reported cells (GPT-4.1 2-needle 57.2%; Gemini 2.5 Pro 94.5%). Claude Sonnet 4 + the three open models have no published MRCR.

Claude Sonnet 4 GPQA Diamond 75.4% is the EXTENDED-THINKING figure (Anthropic's headline table); the no-extended-thinking figure is 70.0%. MMLU-Pro 83.8% is the 'Thinking' vals.ai reproduction. Both are thinking-enabled to match the headline; note if the panel runs Sonnet 4 without extended thinking.

deepseek/deepseek-chat resolves to DeepSeek-V3-0324 (the current deepseek-chat as of the DeepSeek API changelog), NOT the original Dec-2024 DeepSeek-V3 (which scored MMLU-Pro 75.9 / GPQA 59.1). The 0324 numbers (81.2 / 68.4) are used.
n=6 models => Spearman rho is noisy and every missing cell widens CIs. Report the permutation-test p-value alongside rho for G3, and treat the ranking (not the exact rho) as the load-bearing output.
